annotations.title: Income by mesh block — household, personal and family incomes, salaries (by suburb)

description:
**How much do people here earn?** For every mesh block in the suburb: median household, personal and family income for the surrounding area, and salary, deductions and tax for the postcode.

One entry per mesh block in the suburb under `mesh_blocks`, each with its `mb_code`, `population` and `dwellings`. Values only — the matching polygons come from `/shapes/mesh-blocks`.

Every field carries `provenance` — `measured` (at this block), `measured_wider_area` (measured for the SA1 or postcode and repeated on every block in it), `estimate` (our model) or `not_recorded` (not labelled yet) — plus `how`, one sentence on how the number was arrived at (empty when `not_recorded`).

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
